title: intellij_jvm — the IntelliJ JVM debugger embedded in intellij-server

request.description: Start a new JVM under the IntelliJ debug engine.

mainClass.description: Fully-qualified name of the class with the main method. intellij-server resolves classpath, module path, working directory and the java executable from its imported project model.

file.description: Path to the source file declaring the main class; disambiguates multiple classes with the same fully-qualified name.

classPaths.description: Class path override; empty = server-resolved from the project model.

modulePaths.description: JPMS module path override; empty = server-resolved.

moduleName.description: JPMS module owning the main class (server-resolved when omitted).

javaExec.description: java executable override; empty = project JDK.

cwd.description: Working directory of the debuggee ($ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT or server-resolved module dir).

env.description: Extra environment variables for the debuggee.

console.description: internalConsole (default): the server spawns the process and streams output to the Debug console.

stopOnEntry.description: Suspend immediately after the JVM starts.

noDebug.description: true = run without the debugger attached (i.e. RUN).

request.description: Attach to a JVM already listening on JDWP.

hostName.description: Host the JDWP socket listens on. Default: localhost.

port.description: The JDWP port of the target JVM, e.g. 5005 with -agentlib:jdwp=transport=dt_socket,server=y,suspend=n,address=*:5005
